unbalanced-icc_athens2022.derivation: Durfee-Nguyen ASIACRYPT 2000 trivariate Coppersmith (attack on Sun-Yang-Laih AC99 Scheme I, which this challenge instantiates: p 256-bit, q 768-bit, d 300-bit, e~N, ed=1+k*phi). Solve 2 + x*(A - y - z) = 0 (mod e), A=N+1, at root (2k, p, q) with yz=N substituted, so f(root)=2+k*2*phi=2ed=0 mod e. Shift lattice g_{k,i,b}=e^(m-k) x^i y^a z^b f^k (k<m, 1<=i<=m-k, b<2) and h_{k,j}=e^(m-k) y^(a+j) f^k (k<=m, j<=t) with m=8, t=5, a=1, bounds (2^301, 2^256, 2^768): rank 126 square lattice, DN determinant condition margin ~+46 bits/dim. LLL (fpylll, delta=0.99) rows divide column scales exactly; nontrivial short rows vanish over Z at (2k,p,q). Extract p via paper method: substitute z=N/y, resultant in x of two vanishing polys (fraction-free Bareiss over Z[y]), integer roots; verify p|N, then d=e^-1 mod (p-1)(q-1), m=c^d mod N.
